purpose: Acquisition and feature preparation, not model fitting or a completed reviewer response.

feature_validation.failure_action: Stop; do not score added recordings or alter the original cache.

additional_recording_eligibility: Official checksum verified, valid EDF dimensions, all original 22 channels at 256 Hz, explicitly parsed official seizure annotations. No performance-based exclusions. Record every failure or incompatibility.
feature_rules: Original 20 handcrafted features averaged across the original 22 channels; no new filtering or normalization; float32 EEG in volts; same fixed epsilon constants as archived code.
prospective_extended_evaluation: Use existing subject-held-out models and train-only settings on the additional recordings of their held-out case. Added recordings are test-only; original core/calibration/test membership remains unchanged. This is a recording-exposure sensitivity analysis, not a new independent-subject cohort.
remaining_analyses_after_inputs_are_veri: Frozen-model burden, probability calibration and duty/burden summaries for original, additional and combined recording exposure; no denominator-only adjustment.
Full file-level endpoint and original core/calibration/test provenance.
Per-event center-time and end-of-window decision-time timing with pre-onset, at/after-onset-only, missed categories; retain original versus train-selected policy distinctions.
Literature-inspired temporal-rule comparators on common scores with selection confined to original training/calibration recordings; adapted components not full-paper reproductions.
Fixed-gamma sweep figure and correct authorization-fraction axis; subject-level data and paired exploratory uncertainty.
Attribution-lag and independent outcome analyses with explicit scope limits.
Reproducible code, exact environment, manuscript patches, reviewer-by-reviewer response and remaining historical cohort-selection uncertainty.
